name: NH Madrid Lagasca
description: NH Madrid Lagasca hotel is set in the Salamanca district of Madrid, right by the golden mile of luxury shops and designer boutiques. Enjoy a stroll through the Retiro Park and a walk around its famous pond. A longer walk will get you to Plaza Cibeles and Puerta de Alcalá. Business travelers have easy access to the IFEMA Exhibition Complex, which is only 10km away. For quick links to the rest of the city, hop on the metro at the Serrano or Recoletos stations. NH Madrid Lagasca features 100 relaxing rooms with hardwood floors. Each comes with free Wi-Fi, which is also available throughout the hotel. The Superior rooms come with Nespresso machines and mini-bars, and three have spectacular views of Madrid's skyline from their private terraces. Let our breakfast be the highlight of your day; offering up a healthy selection of cold cuts, cheeses, fresh pastries and other delights, it can be enjoyed with fresh fruit juice, fragrant coffee or a hot cup of tea. The bar serves drinks and snacks, which you can enjoy while watching a game on the TV or just relaxing on one of the cozy sofas. Simple dishes can be ordered through our room service, and the La Ventana de Flavia restaurant serves lunch and dinner daily.
